events.quote: After being re-elected to the Reichstag in 1874

events.text: Liebknecht played a key role in the merger of the SDAP and Lassalles ADAV into the Socialist Workers Party of Germany in Gotha.

events.text: Liebknecht became publisher of the newly founded party organ Vorwärts.
